about: Card 92, his pick '(a) Pawn' (run-answers orchestrator-B14-DESK-ANSWERS-Q17-Q18-Q19-Q20-Q23-2026-11-24 (d) and orchestrator-B14-Q20-CLASSIC-PAWN-2026-11-24): Classic's Play tile shows the pawn emoji in place of the crown, ink-matched like the other three, and no play sign. Graded by gate 49's block B (CT_HM_BLOCKS=B) on Home in the Classic skin at 320x568, 375x730, 390x844 and 430x932: TC-HM-015 holds each tile glyph's measured ink scale, and the pawn's is 1.11 where the crown's was 0.99, so the crown coming back reddens it. NOT COVERED: which glyph is drawn is read through its ink scale, not by its character; gate 92 (no two skins share their four tile icons) is not run here; the menu's Style rows are gate 92's; 375x761 is not one of block B's four geometries.
